title: Bine language
description: Trans-Fly language spoken in Papua New Guinea
extract: Bine, also known as Pine, Kunini, Masingara or Oriomo, is a Papuan language of New Guinea. Glottolog lists the following varieties: Boze-Giringarede, Irupi-Drageli, Kunini, Masingle, Sebe, Sogal and Täti.
